caption: The drawing shows a line illustration of a garment, viewed from the back, on a plain, off-white background. The garment appears to be a two-piece outfit consisting of a capelet-style upper piece with elbow-length sleeves and a pair of loose-fitting pants. Both pieces are decorated with a scalloped trim along the edges; this scalloping is visible at the neckline, the hem of the capelet, sleeve edges, the sides, and the hem of the pants. The capelet features a central vertical seam down the back and curved seam lines extending from the shoulder to under the arms. The pants have a bow-like detail or tie at the upper center of the back and vertical seam lines. The entire illustration is rendered in thin, black lines, with no shading or color other than the beige tone of the background.
title: Boy's Suit
